summary: EIA 1.4 says clearance timelines in the report follow the draft EIA Notification 2020. The draft was never notified and is not law. The 2006 Notification governs.
provision: Notification as a whole; catalog note on the 2020 draft
recommendation: Note it as an error in the report's legal basis. The extract does not show that any timeline changed as a result, so do not overstate it. Cite only the 2006 Notification.
